name: NoVACouplePacking_CheckIn

custom.system_prompt: Life-first couple packing scene. Maja and Rafael packing for a short European trip. The check-in time debate surfaces and resolves without Sigma: Maja finds the booking confirmation email with the check-in window, or Rafael checks the airline app. Sigma is never addressed.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bedroom and hallway during couple packing: suitcase zips, drawers, folded clothes, footsteps between rooms, quiet apartment ambience.

initial_prompt: Generate a warm but stressed conversation between Maja and Rafael packing for a short European holiday, later than planned. Maja's checklist has items being ticked off and reinstated. Rafael confirms things that are not yet true — adapters, chargers, documents. At least once a bag gets reopened after being zipped. Something gets found in the wrong place. They talk about the trip, volleyball, their week. The check-in debate — midnight vs 24 hours — surfaces, defers, and returns. This time it resolves without Sigma: Maja pulls up the booking email, or Rafael checks the airline app and reads the time aloud. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.tts_prompt: Energetic, organized, competitive about sport, dry Polish-English humour

user2.name: Rafael
user2.tts_prompt: Easy-going, warm, light Brazilian accent, unhurried
